## [zero customer service](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/669876785566802a0fe5b6af)
zero customer service. Emailed multiple times about my light which has not shipped that was ordered 7/6. NO RESPONSE. This very light is on the site and says “in stock and ready to ship”. We may not be able to move into our home without this light installed bc we can’t get a CO. Lulu and georgia, if you are reading this please reach out — order number 716006

July 6, 2024
